# Enable

> Enable provides rebate management and intelligent pricing software powered by AI, helping B2B manufacturers, distributors, and retailers optimize revenue through strategic partnerships and data-driven pricing decisions.

Enable combines rebate management automation with Flintfox intelligent pricing technology to help companies like The Very Group, WESCO, ANB Canada, and SiteOne maximize profits through AI-powered revenue optimization. The platform serves manufacturing, distribution, and retail industries with tools for supplier collaboration, tiered pricing strategies, and financial analytics.

## Key Topics

- Rebate Management
- Flintfox Intelligent Pricing
- Artificial Intelligence & AI
- Revenue Optimization
- B2B Price Optimization

- Trading Partner Collaboration
- Profit Maximization

- Tiered Pricing Strategies
- Revenue Recognition (IFRS/GAAP)
- Automation
- Strategic Supplier Partnerships
